title: Khamenei is dead, long live the Ayatollah! Trump's 'regime change' comes home
content: Donald Trump's military action against Iran inadvertently strengthened the regime, counter to expectations. In the wake of this, Democrats took control of Congress during the midterm elections, presenting new hurdles for Trump's presidency. Escalating fuel prices and inflation amplified the political fallout faced by Trump and his supporters, complicating his stated priority of focusing on domestic matters rather than international conflicts.

title: 29+ US communities curb new AI data centres; Texas elects pro-pause governor
content: Communities in the US have recently voted on measures to limit the development of new data centres. These measures reflect a growing concern about the impact of data centres on power and water use, and noise. In Texas, the election of Gina Hinojosa as governor may lead to further restrictions on data centre construction. Meanwhile, a majority of voters in Ohio support prohibiting large facilities in their communities.

title: Wyoming landowner wins road access to 640 acres, must pay $61,200
content: After facing challenges in accessing its secluded property in Wyoming, Wagonhound Land & Livestock Company turned to the courts for a solution. Following failed negotiations for access, they sought legal permission for a private road. The Wyoming Supreme Court ruled in favor of the company, confirming the road’s necessity and awarding compensation to the neighboring ranch, while also lifting two restrictions on road standards.

title: Painting bought for £500 identified as Turner, sells for nearly £1.9m
content: A painting once thought to be by a follower of Julius Caesar Ibbetson turned out to be an early creation of JMW Turner. Originally bought for a little over £500 at an April 2024 auction, it underwent restoration, uncovering Turner’s signature. This sparked a remarkable increase in its value, leading to a sale at Sotheby's for about £1.9 million in July 2025.

title: Ohio father's lawsuit over son's fatal police shooting revived on appeal
content: In the wake of his son Elijah Isham's fatal shooting by police, Ralph Isham filed a civil rights lawsuit that faced initial dismissal over legal representation concerns. The district court annulled the original complaint, but the Sixth Circuit intervened, asserting that a case cannot be dismissed merely for being filed without an attorney. This pivotal decision allows the estate to advance its legal claim against the involved officers.

title: How Florida turned toy rabbits into robots to lure pythons & protect Everglades
content: Florida researchers created robotic rabbits to attract invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. These decoys imitate real prey by moving and generating heat, aiding in detection. The project employs remote monitoring to facilitate python removal by the South Florida Water Management District. Traditional methods relied on live rabbits, which posed logistics challenges, making robotic alternatives more practical. Current testing continues with future plans to add scent to enhance effectiveness.

title: Village techie earning Rs 1 lakh a month considers city move over lifestyle
content: In a serene village, a software engineer working remotely is finding his once-peaceful existence turning dull despite financial stability. Limited options for leisure turn weekends into a chore, prompting thoughts of relocating to Kota for greater social engagement and enjoyable activities. Although this shift might strain his budget, it promises a more enriching daily experience, prompting a crucial examination of the harmony between monetary savings and a gratifying lifestyle.

title: Iran’s Hormuz exemption likely to bring relief to India’s oil importers
content: In an interview with Iranian Students’ News Agency (ISNA) Tuesday, Amir Hayat-Moghaddam, deputy chairman of Iranian Parliament’s National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, said, “We have currently exempted four countries — India, China, Iraq and Qatar — from transit restrictions in the Strait of Hormuz. Ships from these countries pass freely, and the Americans do not intercept them either.”

title: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion makeover hits another roadblock
content: Travis Kelce’s $5.35 million Ohio mansion project faces fresh opposition as neighbours raise concerns about potential damage to a century-old sewer line from planned landscaping. Despite spending $7,500 on repairs and revising fence plans, Kelce’s team has encountered another setback. Local officials approved some landscaping but rejected shoreline tree plans, asking for further revisions before granting approval.

title: Ayesha Curry shares heartfelt birthday wishes for Stephen Curry’s 80-year-old family member
content: Ayesha Curry celebrated her grandmother's milestone 80th birthday with a touching tribute shared on Instagram. Following a Warriors game, she enjoyed a playful banter with her husband, Stephen Curry. Ayesha is also gearing up for the release of her new film 'Second Chance Holiday' on November 5, where she portrays a dating coach navigating hurdles during the festive season.

title: Watch: Rare wicketkeeping error hands Renegades last-ball win over Hurricanes
content: Melbourne Renegades achieved a four-wicket victory over Hobart Hurricanes in the Women's Big Bash League. The Hurricanes set a target of 155 runs, with Nicola Carey scoring a crucial 62 runs. In a dramatic final over, a wicketkeeping no-ball decision allowed the Renegades to win. Hayley Matthews contributed significantly with 59 runs despite a late collapse of the team.

title: India thrash South Korea 8-1 to storm into ACT final, set up Japan clash
content: India delivered a stunning display of skill, overpowering South Korea 8-1 in the Asian Champions Trophy semi-final. With Shilanand Lakra and Dilpreet Singh each netting two goals and Harmanpreet Singh converting a key penalty corner, the team regained control after an early goal from their opponents. The momentum carried through the second quarter, as India continued to surge, setting up a final showdown against Japan.

title: Agniveers get 2-year extension, higher pay: Key changes under scheme explained
content: With Diwali approaching, nearly 20,000 Agniveers will have the opportunity to serve for two more years. The Union Cabinet's decision follows the initial batch nearing the end of its four-year service term. As many as 75% of Agniveers were scheduled to leave the armed forces. The revised scheme allows these personnel to gain further experience before being considered for permanent roles.

title: Youth Olympics: Tanvi Patri becomes first Indian woman to reach badminton semis
content: Tanvi Patri has etched her name in the record books by being the first Indian woman to reach the semifinals in badminton. Following an impressive win against Thailand's Kakanik Kungkaew, she previously dominated her group with three straight victories. Tanvi's upcoming match against Japan's Yuzuno Watanabe not only represents a chance for a gold medal but also highlights her bright future in the sport.

title: Unfazed by Emerging Teams Asia Cup snub, Priyansh Arya vows to keep pushing
content: Despite missing out on the Emerging Teams Asia Cup, Priyansh Arya remains unfazed, determined to keep pushing for opportunities. The Delhi batter discusses his explosive white-ball game, competition with Abhishek Sharma and Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, his red-ball growth and his ambition to keep knocking on the door of India selection.

title: Geeta Tandon Alleges Disrespect: says India Ke Top 1% team made her wait
content: Geeta Tandon recounted a frustrating nine-hour wait as a guest on Anil Kapoor's show, lamenting the lack of communication from the production team during this unexpected delay. Feeling disregarded, she voiced her concerns about their treatment of her and her son. In response, both Anil Kapoor and Farah Khan publicly apologized, and Geeta expressed hope that her experience could encourage better treatment for future guests.

title: H-1B, immigration and Trump: Why Indian-American voters turned away from Republicans
content: With Democrats gaining Congressional control, Indian-Americans are grappling with uncertainty regarding immigration rules and job opportunities. Heightened fears about H-1B visa restrictions and deportation have taken center stage. In addition, increasing discrimination and the prevailing political climate are altering feelings of identity among the community. New survey data reveals a trend towards favoring Democratic candidates, indicating that the outcomes of the midterms might significantly influence the Indian-American experience.

title: 'Accepted with great excitement': Nadal's journey from Real Madrid fan to boardroom
content: Rafael Nadal has been offered a position on Real Madrid's Board of Directors and has accepted the proposal. This appointment will be submitted for ratification by the club's General Assembly of Delegate Members. Nadal expressed his gratitude and excitement about contributing to the club's future. He remains active in public engagements following his retirement from professional tennis.

title: Owaisi urges UP Muslims to strengthen political identity after El-Sayed’s Michigan win
content: In a rallying cry, Asaduddin Owaisi urged the Muslim community in Uttar Pradesh to embrace and amplify their political identity following Abdul El-Sayed's groundbreaking Senate victory. This election marks a pivotal moment, as El-Sayed becomes the first Muslim to occupy a Senate seat in the US, sending ripples across India. Owaisi's comments illuminate the ongoing quest for robust political representation among Muslims in the region.

title: 'One match doesn't decide a career': Anshul Kamboj's strong response to critics
content: Anshul Kamboj made a significant impact in India's ODI against New Zealand, skillfully taking two wickets and aiding in restricting the opponent to a modest score of 185. His disciplined bowling, emphasised through consistent lengths and a wobble seam delivery, was crucial. With contributions from Virat Kohli and Shubman Gill, India clinched the win by achieving the revised target.

title: Diwali rush, GRAP curbs bring Delhi to a crawl: Long jams leave commuters fuming
content: Delhi is facing significant traffic congestion as festive shopping intensifies ahead of Diwali. Reports indicate long queues of vehicles and gridlocked roads across various locations. Commuters are expressing frustration over insufficient traffic management and enforcement of parking rules. Major intersections and market areas are particularly affected, with delays frequently lasting over 30 minutes. Authorities are urged to enhance the deployment of traffic personnel to alleviate congestion.

title: 'Normalise, recognise, formalise': Nadda says Cong opposing SIR to help outsiders
content: Union health minister JP Nadda accused the Congress party of opposing the Special Intensive Revision of voter lists. He alleged that their actions are aimed at protecting outsiders who support their political ambitions. Nadda criticized the Congress for undermining the credibility of the Election Commission when faced with electoral losses. He noted that the current electoral process includes Booth Level Officers facilitating voter registration door-to-door.

title: SC rejects woman's plea to terminate six-month pregnancy over marital discord
content: the woman's husband opposed the termination, arguing that he too had a right over the unborn child and was willing to take care of the baby after birth . the case came before a bench of justices who expressed concern over the request .

title: 'We are descendants of Krishna, fear no one': Tejashwi hits out at BJP, RSS & Dhirendra Shastri
content: Tejashwi Yadav accuses BJP and RSS of targeting his father . he also criticizes Dhirendra Shastri over his alleged remarks about Lord Krishna . his father, Lalu Prasad, is still forced to make appearances in court .

title: How Democrats clawed back support from five key voter groups in US midterms
content: voters under 30, Hispanic voters, black voters, moderates and lower-income households shifted towards Democratic candidates . young voters recorded one of the sharpest swings Nearly 7 in 10 voters under 30 said they supported the Democratic candidate in their local House race .

title: Sharad Pawar hospitalised again, hours after discharge
content: pawar was admitted to Breach Candy Hospital on friday . the veteran leader was discharged earlier in the day . he was admitted for a general check-up and medical observation following complaints of pleuritic pain .

title: Govt paves way for all Agniveers' absorption into armed forces
content: the union cabinet’s decision will clear the way for three lakh Agniveers . the first batch of 18,300 will complete their four-year tenure by Dec 31 this year . a two-year extension would provide enrollment of all willing Agnives as regular soldiers .

title: 'Our voters backed Democrats': Vance blames Iran war for Republicans' midterms rout
content: vp JD Vance attributed the midterm election rout to supporters' dissatisfaction with the Trump administration . "we might do better than the polls suggest," he said . the main problem is that many people who voted for Trump/Vance in 2024 voted in 2026 .

title: Midterm gamble, sliding stocks: Elon Musk's pricey election hangover continues
content: the world's richest man spent nearly half a billion dollars backing Republican candidates in the midterm elections . but the results dealt a setback to Trump and Musk, one of his closest allies . the results could complicate his business plans and weigh on investor sentiment towards his businesses .

title: Srinagar MP’s exit part of BJP’s ‘Op Lotus’ plan in J&K, says NC
content: BJP has succeeded in getting Aga Sahib (Mehdi) out of NC . he has now joined a force that has tried two or three times over the past 80-90 years to weaken us, but we managed to defeat those attempts earlier .

title: Scottish MPs seek repeal of law allowing Indian national Manivannan to enter Parl
content: the recommendation comes after govt Q Manivannan, from Chennai, was elected as an MSP to the Edinburgh and Lothians East seat in may for the Scottish Green Party . the Scottish parliament’s Standards, Procedures and Public Appointments Committee has stated that it does not accept the premise that there should be a general right for non-UK citizens with limited leave to remain to be councillors .

title: Manipur violence panel gets sixth extension, deadline pushed to May 2027
content: this is the sixth extension granted to the commission since the commission was constituted in sept 2023 . it was required to submit its report by Nov 2027 . the commission also tasked with examining whether there were any lapses or dereliction of duty by the authorities concerned or individuals .

title: Andhra, Kerala top ease of vehicle ownership index; UP, Bihar at bottom: Report
content: Andhra Pradesh, Kerala and Tamil Nadu are the top-performing states in ease of vehicle ownership . Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and west Bengal rank at the bottom, reflecting wide disparities in procedures for transferring ownership of used vehicles . none of the states figured in the ‘high ease’ or excellent category .

title: Republicans trumped, stumped, and dumped as Dems win both House and Senate
content: Democrats swept both chambers of Congress, taking control of the house and Senate . the rout of the Republicans is a political bloodbath of epic proportions . voters hand him and his MAGA-infused Republican Party an electoral pink slip .

title: US sanctions Indian couple, 9 firms over alleged Iran oil trade fraud
content: the sanctions were announced under the Trump administration's "Operation Economic Outcast" the alleged operators of a "vast criminal network" the network allegedly helped sanctioned ships, including those operating on behalf of Iran's military and its proxies, continue their operations .

title: From Jaipur roots to Florida victory, Pia Dandiya keeps family ties close
content: "it's an unimaginable moment for the entire family," her father tells TOI . she was born and raised in us, but her father says she likes Indian food, culture and Bollywood . her parents had once hoped she would become a doctor .

title: Rest, Supriya & I’ll look after country, PM Modi said to have told Sharad Pawar
content: the 85-year-old veteran politician was admitted to a private hospital in april . he was discharged 2 days later . "the PM told Pawar Saheb that Supriya is now ready and that he will look after the country," he says .

title: ‘It would destroy Democrats’: Trump warns against impeachment after midterm losses
content: american president warns against impeachment proceedings against him . he says such a move would politically destroy their party . his remarks come a day after a sweeping setback in the midterm elections . president obama says he is not worried about the possibility .

title: Trump's space declaration signals new Moon contest; India weighs its options
content: a proclamation titled “The American Declaration of Freedom in Space” sparks a new Moon rules contest . the proclamations force India to balance artemis ties and 2047 ambitions against strategic autonomy . obama: if space is a global commons or become an arena of competing national interests?

title: ‘Call me Senator’: First Muslim elected to Senate has an India link
content: the first Muslim to be elected to the US Senate in American history wasted little time in igniting MAGA outrage . he reminded president veep JD Vance that they would have to get used to him . "habibi" in Arabic is "my love"

title: French fried: Texas Republican pays the price for anti-Indian politics
content: inflammatory remarks by the Republican official earned him and his party electoral karma . defeat has given a stark electoral warning to an increasingly uncomfortable contradiction within the Republican Party . a party that spent years courting Indian-American voters is now struggling with a section of its own political base questioning whether Indians belong in Texas .

title: 'Largely true': Trump admits Iran war cost GOP midterms, says he'd do it again
content: he says the war with Iran contributed to the party's poor performance in the 2026 midterm elections . but he defends the military campaign, saying he has to act to prevent Tehran from developing nuclear weapons . he said the rise in petrol prices had affected voters in the short term .
